headline: Sergio Agüero scored 24 from chances worth 17.5
body: The biggest gap in the Premier League among players with 20+ shots. An average finisher scores that many from the same chances about one season in 22: some of it is likely skill, but don't pay for all of it.

headline: of men valued at €10.0M+ have a top-3 lookalike at half the price or less
body: 265 of 282 outfield players. Style is cheap to find. What the price adds is level, age and contract, so treat a cheaper lookalike as a lead to check.

headline: Sergio Agüero's closest match in the women's game plays for Manchester City WFC
body: Khadija Shaw (FA Women's Super League 2023/24) is Sergio Agüero's closest match among the women, and he is her closest among the men, out of 2,170 players ranked within their own leagues.
